sources.title: mohommed/Lucet-2B-Frontier-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 🏛️ Lucet-2B-Frontier (Roman Deity of Light & Illumination) Lucet-2B is an autonomous reasoning, coding, and systems model built on Liquid AI's Tri-Hybrid architecture (Gated Short Convolutions + Sliding Window Attention + Global GQA) via Multi-Dimensional Smart Deep Training (MTA-SDT) on high-signal curated datasets.
